name: ui-clone
description: Use for frontend work when the user wants to clone, copy, recreate or match a UI, section, component, effect or animation from a reference: a live URL, their local dev server, a video, GIF or screen recording (web or mobile app), or a Figma design. Covers pixel-accurate UI (layout, fonts, spacing, colours), animations and interactions (load, hover, click, scroll, page transitions, loaders, marquees, springs), and effects (gradients, blurs, shaders, canvas/WebGL backgrounds), rebuilt in the user'
